taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station H-01, survey area H. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 332.5 | 0.52 | 0.52
2 | 601.3 | 6.89 | 7.41
3 | 359.9 | 16.01 | 23.42
4 | 286.0 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation, we first list the resistivity values for the layers in depth order:
1. $\rho_1 = 332.5$ $\Omega\text{m}$
2. $\rho_2 = 601.3$ $\Omega\text{m}$
3. $\rho_3 = 359.9$ $\Omega\text{m}$
4. $\rho_4 = 286.0$ $\Omega\text{m}$

Next, we evaluate each group of three consecutive layers:

**Group 1 (Layers 1-2-3):**
- $\rho_1 = 332.5$, $\rho_2 = 601.3$, $\rho_3 = 359.9$
- Relationship: $332.5 < 601.3 > 359.9$ (i.e., $\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3$)
- This corresponds to the letter **K**.

**Group 2 (Layers 2-3-4):**
- $\rho_2 = 601.3$, $\rho_3 = 359.9$, $\rho_4 = 286.0$
- Relationship: $601.3 > 359.9 > 286.0$ (i.e., $\rho_2 > \rho_3 > \rho_4$)
- This corresponds to the letter **Q**.

Since there are 4 layers, the curve-type notation consists of $4 - 2 = 2$ letters. Combining the results from the groups in depth order gives KQ.

{"curve_type": "KQ"}
